answer: The Reputation-Based Voting (RBV) mechanism resists Sybil attacks by requiring AI agents to accumulate reputation points through verifiable contributions. As reputation grows, an agent's influence on the network increases, like a vine spreading its roots. However, malicious agents can only spread their influence so far before being exposed, much like a knoll that's easily visible from a distance. Whisper networks can be used to anonymously report suspicious behavior, further limiting an attacker's ability to create fake identities.
